scripts.dev: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs');for(const p of ['next.config.ts','src/app/page.tsx'])if(!fs.existsSync(p)){console.error('[producer:error] missing apps/web/'+p+'; WP09/WP10 must provide the web runtime');process.exit(1)}" && next dev
scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs');for(const p of ['next.config.ts','src/app/page.tsx'])if(!fs.existsSync(p)){console.error('[producer:error] missing apps/web/'+p+'; WP09/WP10 must provide the web build');process.exit(1)}" && next build
scripts.start: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs');const p='.next/BUILD_ID';if(!fs.existsSync(p)){console.error('[producer:error] missing apps/web/'+p+'; run the production web build first');process.exit(1)}" && next start
scripts.format:check: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs');const p='next.config.ts';if(!fs.existsSync(p)){console.error('[producer:error] missing apps/web/'+p+'; WP09 must provide web configuration');process.exit(1)}" && prettier --check .
scripts.lint: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs');const p='eslint.config.mjs';if(!fs.existsSync(p)){console.error('[producer:error] missing apps/web/'+p+'; WP09 must provide lint configuration');process.exit(1)}" && eslint .
scripts.typecheck: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs');const p='tsconfig.json';if(!fs.existsSync(p)){console.error('[producer:error] missing apps/web/'+p+'; WP09 must provide TypeScript configuration');process.exit(1)}" && tsc --noEmit
scripts.test: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs');for(const p of ['vitest.config.ts','tests/foundation'])if(!fs.existsSync(p)){console.error('[producer:error] missing apps/web/'+p+'; WP09/WP10 must provide component validation');process.exit(1)}" && vitest run
scripts.test:e2e: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs');for(const p of ['playwright.config.ts','tests/foundation/proxy.e2e.ts'])if(!fs.existsSync(p)){console.error('[producer:error] missing apps/web/'+p+'; WP09/WP10 must provide same-origin smoke validation');process.exit(1)}" && playwright test
